findings.observation: The unified docs router rejects arguments for two zero-argument main() functions even though CI and active docs invoke those commands with arguments.
findings.method: Run the exact router commands used by CI and compare them with the direct module entrypoints.

evidence.observation: Returns rc=2: scripts.docs.checks.verify.main() does not accept command arguments.
The direct module accepts --skip-build and enters the documented verification chain.
The Proof-or-Stop evidence producer uses the router form that returns rc=2.
The router returns rc=2 before report generation while the direct module parses the same flags.
The scheduled workflow uses the rejected router form.

findings.expected: All documented and CI-owned scripts.docs commands accept and forward their declared arguments through the unified router.
findings.actual: verify and check-kpi expose zero-argument main() functions and the router rejects any forwarded arguments before argparse runs.
findings.impact: Scheduled docs KPI publication and the docs/runtime Proof-or-Stop evidence producer cannot execute their declared commands; release evidence is incomplete.
findings.root_cause: Two routed modules still parse global sys.argv instead of accepting argv like the governed router contract expects.
findings.remediation: Make verify.main and report_docs_kpi.main accept argv, pass argv into argparse, and add exact router regression tests for the workflow commands.
findings.automation: Router regression tests for exact CI argv.

findings.observation: The published documentation hub advertises governance baseline v6.1.9 while RULES.md is v6.1.10.
findings.method: Run the repository version-consistency gate and inspect both canonical headers.

evidence.observation: RULES.md header is 6.1.10 and index.md line 132 still says v6.1.9.

findings.expected: The published hub points to the current RULES governance version.
findings.actual: The hub is one governance release behind and the required version gate fails.
findings.impact: Required docs, tests, and release workflows fail; contributors receive stale governance-version metadata.
findings.root_cause: The RULES version bump was not synchronized to the published docs index.
findings.remediation: Update the governance baseline statement in docs/00-project/index.md to the current RULES header and run the version gate.

findings.observation: The recently integrated prompt-library surface is not fully classified in MkDocs navigation and the deterministic documentation cleanup inventory was not regenerated.
findings.method: Run the full link/governance gate and the cleanup inventory checker on a clean tracked snapshot of 8ab59e239589.

evidence.observation: Returns rc=1 with 52 new outside-nav paths; most are prompt fragments and library cards.
The published Prompts nav covers only a subset of the new library and fragment surfaces.
Returns rc=1 on a clean snapshot; both JSON and Markdown generated inventories drift.

findings.expected: New tracked documentation is intentionally classified and generated inventories are refreshed in the same change without increasing debt budgets.
findings.actual: 52 tracked docs are unclassified relative to the exact baseline and both cleanup inventory artifacts are stale.
findings.impact: The canonical docs verification chain fails before strict MkDocs build, so documentation changes cannot satisfy required CI.
findings.root_cause: Prompt-library integration added tracked docs without completing navigation classification and generator refresh.
findings.remediation: Classify or consolidate the new docs through the existing published/repo-only ownership model without increasing the not-in-nav baseline, then regenerate cleanup inventory through its owner command.

findings.observation: The non-AI documentation navigation KPI breaches both the hard outside-nav limit and the orphan budget.
findings.method: Run the exact weekly KPI implementation directly with the workflow thresholds.

evidence.observation: Returns rc=1: outside nav=139 > 135; orphan candidates=14 > 0.
Ten sequence/state-machine descriptions, one governance plan, and three root-level analyses comprise the 14 orphan candidates.

findings.expected: Outside-nav docs remain at or below 135 and orphan candidates remain zero.
findings.actual: The exact workflow policy reports 139 outside-nav docs and 14 orphans.
findings.impact: The weekly docs KPI gate fails and multiple active-looking documents are undiscoverable from navigation or inbound links.
findings.root_cause: Navigation and relocation/link cleanup did not keep pace with retained active and analysis documents.
findings.remediation: Add meaningful navigation/inbound links or relocate/archive the proven orphan surfaces and reduce actual outside-nav count without raising limits or exclusions.
findings.automation: Existing weekly KPI workflow with fail-on-breach.
